title: ToxicLand [Demo]
description: 1.21.11 Server - Vanilla and Resource Pack: Weapons + Zombie
body:
The server is fully powered by its own mechanics, depending on the texture pack.
![9 Weapon + 15+ Melee weapons (Animated)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9db66d2ad386b32d906d8d413165f5b33f28e1c_0.webp)

This server is still in Alpha version mode. And while behind the scenes it is preparing to become a full-fledged game project.
